expected.rationale: Multiple overlays (cookie banner + newsletter popup) are blocking the viewport. dismiss_overlays handles all at once; hide_element targets only one by ID.

metadata.notes: User wants ALL popups cleared. dismiss_overlays is the batch tool; hide_element would require knowing each specific tag ID.
